title: Stabiliser formula on the induced space
body_html:
Stabiliser formula on the induced space

Fix the input data of the induction construction: $G' \le G$ acting cellularly on $X'$, a cosheaf $P$ of subgroups of $G$ on $X'$ satisfying (P1) $nP_En^{-1} = P_{n \cdot E}$ for $n \in G'$ and (P2) $P_E \cap G' \subseteq \Fix_{G'}(E)$, and the induced space $X = G \times^P X'$ with cellular embedding $\iota : X' \hookrightarrow X,\ E \mapsto [(1, E)]$ (cf.\ [[node:equivariant_sheaves.induction_GxP_X]]).

Throughout we identify $X'$ with $\iota(X') \subseteq X$ and write $\Fix_G(E)$ for the setwise stabiliser in $X$.

Lemma.

  1. For every cell $E \in [\![X']\!]$ and every $g \in G$, $$\Fix_G(g \cdot E) \;=\; {}^g\!\bigl(\Fix_{G'}(E) \cdot P_E\bigr).$$ In particular $\Fix_G(E) = \Fix_{G'}(E) \cdot P_E$.
  2. $P_E \subseteq \Fix_G(E)$ for every cell $E$.
proof_html:
By $G$-equivariance of stabilisers, $\Fix_G(g \cdot E) = g\,\Fix_G(E)\,g^{-1}$, so it suffices to treat $g = 1$.

($\supseteq$). Let $\hat g = u \cdot p$ with $u \in \Fix_{G'}(E)$, $p \in P_E$. We show $[(up, E)]_{\sim} = [(1, E)]_{\sim}$. Apply the $\sim$-relation from [[node:equivariant_sheaves.induction_GxP_X]] with $n := u \in G'$: $n \cdot E = u \cdot E = E$ (since $u \in \Fix_{G'}(E)$), and $(up)^{-1} \cdot 1 \cdot n = p^{-1} u^{-1} u = p^{-1} \in P_E$. Hence $\hat g \in \Fix_G(E)$.

($\subseteq$). Let $\hat g \in \Fix_G(E)$. From the definition of $\sim$ applied to $(1, E)$ and $(\hat g, E)$ there exists $n \in G'$ with $n \cdot E = E$ (so $n \in \Fix_{G'}(E)$) and $\hat g^{-1} n \in P_E$, i.e.\ $\hat g \in n \cdot P_E^{-1} = n P_E$. By (P1), $\Fix_{G'}(E)$ normalises $P_E$ (as $\Fix_{G'}(E) \le G'$ conjugates $P_E$ to $P_{n \cdot E} = P_E$), so $n P_E = P_E n \subseteq \Fix_{G'}(E) \cdot P_E$.

Statement (2). For $p \in P_E$, and $x \in E$ in the relative interior of $E$, cosheaf-constancy of $P$ on the open cell gives $p \in P_x$, hence by (1) applied at the point $x$ (or equivalently at $E$), $p \in \Fix_G(x)$. Since $\Fix_G(E) = \bigcap_{x \in E^\circ} \Fix_G(x)$ and this holds for every $x$ in the relative interior of $E$, $p \in \Fix_G(E)$. $\square$

Downstream

Statement (1) is used in the proof that $X'$ is a QFD of the induced space with the sharp subgroup $G'$ (X' is a quasi-fundamental domain of the induced space). Statement (2) is used in the descent of the face relation to $\mathrm{InducedSpace}$ (CW structure and QFD property on G ×^P X' and ι : X' → G ×^P X' is a cellular embedding (poset form)).

Lean formalization

The statement (1) specialised to $g = 1$ is InducedSpace.mem_stabilizer_iota_iff:

lean theorem mem_stabilizer_iota_iff (E : X') (m : G) : m ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G (iota d E) ↔ ∃ u ∈ MulAction.stabilizer d.G' E, ∃ p ∈ d.P E, m = u * p

The two half-inclusions are exposed as

```lean theorem P_le_stabilizer_iota (E : X') : d.P E ≤ MulAction.stabilizer G (iota d E)

theorem fix_G'_le_stabilizer_iota (E : X') {n : G} (hn : n ∈ MulAction.stabilizer d.G' E) : n ∈ MulAction.stabilizer G (iota d E) ```

P_le_stabilizer_iota is statement (2); fix_G'_le_stabilizer_iota records the $\Fix_{G'}(E) \le \Fix_G(E)$ half of statement (1) (the $\supseteq$ direction restricted to $u = \hat g$, $p = 1$). The full factorisation is mem_stabilizer_iota_iff. The generic $g \ne 1$ form is obtained by transporting along the Mathlib equivariance MulAction.stabilizer_smul_eq_stabilizer_map_conj.
